page.layout: One printed page: running head and page number at top; upper block of italic verse lines (epitaph continuation) full width; then a rule; then heading and verse lines of the Peucer memorial poem in roman and italic; left margin shows cut-off fragments of the verse line starts, which are part of the text block; no marginal notes of substance.

l.i: gimus, in media nobis quum morte relinquas,
npe etiam nobis Vere post funera Viuis,

main_text.l: virtutibus omnibus viri, F. magni illius

l.i: Qnum isto patrem nato, natumque parentem:
Hunc Vero nimis, ah, festina morte peremptum
Tu Peucer is quam dura hac fata duobus
Sapiis, hunc ferua, quo salvo dives habebis

page.notes: Top lines are cut at the left edge; several words are doubtful because of the long s and the mixed italic/roman setting. The first line's opening word is partly obscured by a stain. The line "Euceros" and the "Qnum"/"Qued" initials are uncertain; a dark mark sits near the left margin, not text. Right-margin ornaments and specks are not printed text.
